recipes.title: Turkey Sausage & Hash Brown Breakfast Burritos (freezer)

items.i: large russet potato, peeled and grated

steps: Hash brown

Grate the potato, salt it, and squeeze out as much liquid as possible in a clean towel. Press into a lightly sprayed nonstick pan over medium heat; cook 3–4 minutes, flip and cook 3–5 more until crisp and cooked through. Set aside.
Turkey sausage

Mix the turkey with the fennel, garlic powder, cumin, onion powder, sugar and salt. Press flat into a hot sprayed skillet like a giant patty, sear 2–3 minutes, flip and cook just to 165°F (74°C). Cut into small pieces; don't overcook, lean turkey dries out fast.
Eggs
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet, cook the pepper and onion with salt 3–4 minutes, then add the whisked eggs and scramble until just set.
Assemble
Warm the tortillas. Layer egg scramble, turkey, 1½–2 tbsp cheese, crumbled hash brown and cilantro, then roll tightly. Optionally toast seam-side down to seal.
Store
Fridge: cool and wrap in plastic wrap for the week. Freezer: wrap, freeze, then reheat in a 400–450°F (200–230°C) oven until hot through.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per burrito (6). Triple the batch and freeze for a month's worth.

recipes.title: Healthy Chicken Fried Rice (meal prep)

items.i: pinch of white pepper, salt and cooking spray

steps: Season the wok
Heat a generous amount of oil in the wok until smoking, turn off the heat, pour it out and wipe the wok clean.
Sear the chicken
Heat 1 tbsp oil until ripping hot. Spread the chicken out and sear undisturbed 3–4 minutes, flip and sear 2–3 more until browned and about 90% cooked. Remove.
Vegetables
Stir-fry the carrot, shallots and chilies with a little salt for 2–3 minutes until softened.
Rice
Return the chicken with the cold rice and stir-fry until the rice is hot and the chicken is just cooked through.
Egg & finish
Push everything aside, spray the gap, scramble the 2 eggs there, then toss together with the peas, soy sauce and white pepper until hot.
Store
Fridge for the week, or pack tightly in zip bags and freeze; reheat the sealed bag in a pot of hot (not boiling) water until hot.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per serving (6). The rice must be cooked the day before and chilled, or it turns mushy.

recipes.title: Shrimp Coconut Red Curry (freezer-friendly)

items.i: fish sauce and salt, to taste
cooked rice, lime wedges and cilantro

steps: Aromatics
Heat the oil in a pot over medium. Sweat the shallots, garlic and galangal with a pinch of salt for 2 minutes.
Curry paste
Add the curry paste and cook until fragrant and it starts to stick, then deglaze with the stock. Add the palm sugar if using.
Shrimp
Bring to a simmer, add the shrimp (and up to 1/2 cup water if it looks shallow), boil, then reduce to low and simmer 5–8 minutes.
Finish
Stir in the light coconut milk and lime leaves, turn off the heat and season with salt and fish sauce.
Store
Vacuum-seal (or zip-bag) single servings flat and freeze. Reheat a frozen bag in a pot of very hot, not boiling, water for 5–10 minutes and pour over rice.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per serving of curry (rice not included).

recipes.title: Spinach Pesto Double-Meat Panini

items.i: thin-sliced deli turkey (140 g per sandwich)
thin-sliced deli ham (140 g per sandwich)

steps: Pesto
Blend the garlic, parmesan, salt, water, spinach and basil until very smooth, then stream in the olive oil. Taste for salt.
Assemble
Split the buns and spread pesto on both insides. Layer 140 g turkey, 140 g ham, a slice of Swiss and a sprinkle of sun-dried tomatoes; close.
Store
Wrap unpressed in plastic wrap and refrigerate, or freeze. Thaw a frozen sandwich at room temp about 10 minutes before pressing.
Press
Press in a panini press or two-sided griddle at 375°F (190°C) for 5–8 minutes until flat, crisp and the cheese is melted. Cut in half.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per panini using ciabatta buns; the numbers change with your bread.
